confidence_notes: I based the food and drink prices on crowd-sourced cost-of-living figures from 2026. Those sources put a 0.5 L pub beer at about EUR 4.8 to 5.5, a cappuccino at about EUR 3.7 to 4.2, a budget meal at about EUR 10 to 25 and a mid-range dinner for two at about EUR 60 to 100. I converted euros to US dollars at about 1.10 USD per EUR, using the euro and US dollar values of the AUD on the 18 November 2026 RBA observation. Prices in the Old Town are higher than these averages. The cocktail and wine prices are less certain because I did not search for them. I estimated them from how they usually compare with beer prices in Tallinn and other Baltic cities. The accommodation prices are my own general estimates for July, Tallinn's peak season, which includes cruise-ship and Finnish visitors. I did not check any booking sites or listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tallinn is priced above Riga and Vilnius and below Helsinki. Restaurant prices are close to those in Prague or Ljubljana's tourist areas.
